title: 真实产品电商主图
promptCN: 以我上传的[产品素材]为唯一产品来源，制作一张[1080×1080或1080×1440]电商主图。完整保留产品的颜色、尺寸比例、结构、标识和材质，不拉伸、不压扁、不凭空增加部件。产品作为视觉中心，背景使用[背景风格]，以[主卖点]建立信息层级。文字严格使用：[标题]、[副标题]、[参数]。为标题预留清晰安全区，避免文字遮挡产品；无法准确呈现的文字留空，供后期排版。光影与产品接触面自然，整体清爽，手机上可辨读。
promptEN: Using my uploaded [product asset] as the only product source, create a [1080×1080 or 1080×1440] e-commerce main image. Preserve color, proportions, structure, logos and material; do not stretch, flatten or invent parts. Make the product the focal point against [background style], prioritizing [main benefit]. Use only this text: [headline], [subtitle], [specifications]. Reserve readable text space without covering the product. Leave text blank if it cannot be rendered accurately. Keep contact shadows natural and the image readable on a phone.

title: 电商详情页信息架构
promptCN: 你是一名电商视觉策划。根据[产品资料]，为[目标用户]设计宽度1080px的移动端详情页方案。按首屏主张、核心卖点、使用场景、结构细节、规格参数、购买答疑安排模块。每个模块给出标题、30字以内文案、建议素材、版式及预计高度。所有性能描述仅使用资料中的可验证信息；缺失数据标注待补充。文字具体，避免空泛的高端、领先和绝对化承诺。输出一份可直接交给设计师的制作清单。
promptEN: Act as an e-commerce visual planner. Based on [product information], plan a 1080px-wide mobile detail page for [target customer]. Structure it as first-screen proposition, core benefits, use cases, construction details, specifications and purchase FAQ. For each module give a headline, short copy, asset needs, layout and estimated height. Use only verifiable claims from the supplied material, mark missing data, and avoid unsupported superlatives. Output a designer-ready production list.

title: 白底商品精修
promptCN: 精修上传的[产品照片]，输出干净的纯白背景商品图，比例[1:1]。保持真实外观、颜色、商标、边缘形状和各部件位置，修复灰尘与拍摄瑕疵，保留真实材质纹理。让产品完整出现在画面中，四周留安全边距，补充柔和自然的接触阴影。不增加配件、不改变结构、不生成新的商品。
promptEN: Retouch my uploaded [product photo] into a clean pure-white product image in [1:1] format. Preserve appearance, color, logo, edges and component positions. Remove dust and photographic defects while keeping material texture. Show the entire product with safe margins and a soft contact shadow. Do not add accessories, change its structure or generate a different product.

title: 科技硬件展示背景
promptCN: 生成一张用于展示[内存/显卡/主板]的[9:16]背景，只生成背景，不生成产品。主题为[冷蓝科技/黑红极简/冰晶/熔岩黑曜石]。在画面中下部预留宽阔、干净的产品展示区域，设置简洁底座，主光来自[方向]，轮廓光颜色为[颜色]。上方预留标题区域，避免文字、品牌、复杂装饰和密集纹理。画面高级、克制，前后景层次清晰。
promptEN: Generate a [9:16] background for displaying [memory / graphics card / motherboard]. Generate only the background, not the product. Theme: [cool blue technology / minimal black and red / ice crystal / lava and obsidian]. Leave a wide clean display area in the lower center, with a simple pedestal, light from [direction] and [color] rim lighting. Reserve headline space above. Avoid text, logos, dense textures and complicated props. Keep the depth clear and composition restrained.

title: 同款主图的方形与竖版
promptCN: 以上传的[主图]和[产品素材]为参考，分别输出1080×1080和1080×1440的电商主图布局方案。保持同一视觉风格、文字内容、品牌识别和卖点顺序；根据比例重新分配标题、产品和参数的位置，不直接拉伸或机械裁切。用表格列出每版的元素、位置百分比、宽高、对齐方式和留白。产品比例始终以真实素材为准，指出需要人工校对的文字与参数。
tags: 同款主图的方形与竖版
promptEN: Using [reference main image] and [product assets], plan both 1080×1080 and 1080×1440 e-commerce layouts. Preserve visual style, copy, brand recognition and benefit order. Reposition the headline, product and specifications to suit each aspect ratio rather than stretching or mechanically cropping. In a table list each element, percentage position, dimensions, alignment and spacing. Keep product proportions authentic and mark text and specifications needing manual checking.

title: 自然光生活场景
promptCN: 以我上传的[产品]为主体，放入[生活场景]中。保持产品真实颜色、形状、比例和材质，镜头采用[俯拍/平视/近景]，自然光从侧面进入，环境色为[配色]，道具仅使用[允许的道具]，且不能遮挡主要结构。产品占画面[比例]，留出标题空间，光影与透视一致。避免漂浮、错误反射、变形和多余产品。
promptEN: Place my uploaded [product] in [lifestyle scene], preserving authentic color, shape, proportions and material. Use an [overhead / eye-level / close-up] view, side natural light, [palette] and only [allowed props]. Do not obscure important product structure. The product occupies [percentage] of the frame with room for a headline. Keep light, shadows and perspective consistent. Avoid floating objects, incorrect reflections, distortion and additional products.

title: 主图视觉校对清单
promptCN: 检查[参考图]与[成品图]的差异，按整体结构、产品比例、文字内容、参数数量、字体、间距、裁切、颜色、阴影依次比较。把问题按影响购买理解的严重程度排序，逐项指出具体位置、参考状态、当前状态和修改方式。优先检查型号、数量、规格是否完全一致；看不清的内容标记待确认，不猜测。给出修改后复查清单。
promptEN: Compare [reference image] with [finished image], checking overall structure, product proportions, copy, specification quantities, typography, spacing, cropping, color and shadows. Rank issues by their effect on purchase understanding. For each identify location, expected appearance, current appearance and correction. Prioritize exact model, quantity and specification matching. Mark illegible information as unconfirmed rather than guessing. Provide a post-correction checklist.

title: 产品卖点提炼
promptCN: 根据[产品资料]和[使用人群]，提炼5个电商卖点。每项按真实属性、用户收益、适合场景、可用证据输出。将标题控制在8字以内，配一条20字以内说明。不编造参数、不使用无依据的最高级或医疗效果。缺少的证据单独列在末尾。
promptEN: From [product information] and [target audience], extract five e-commerce benefits. For each give the authentic attribute, user benefit, use case and supporting evidence, plus a concise headline and short explanation. Do not invent specifications, unsupported superlatives or medical effects. List missing evidence separately.

title: 品牌广告海报构图
promptCN: 为[品牌]的[产品]设计一张[比例]广告海报。目标受众是[人群]，唯一传播重点为[核心信息]。视觉风格为[风格]，背景颜色[颜色]，产品以真实素材呈现并保持比例。标题为[标题]，附加文字为[文案]，只允许这些文字。给出一个主视觉焦点，避免拥挤道具，品牌和文案拥有清楚的安全区。
promptEN: Design a [ratio] advertising poster for [brand] and [product], aimed at [audience], communicating only [core message]. Style: [style]. Background: [color]. Use the actual product asset with correct proportions. Headline: [headline]. Other copy: [copy]. Allow no other text. Establish one main visual focal point, avoid crowded props, and reserve clear space for brand and copy.

title: 详情页参数检查
promptCN: 对照[原始产品资料]校对[详情页文案]。逐条检查尺寸、数量、型号、颜色、材质、适配对象和性能描述。输出问题表：位置、当前内容、资料依据、建议修改、确认状态。资料没有提供的数值不要补全；对可能引起误解的描述给出更准确表达。保留已确认正确的参数。
promptEN: Check [detail-page copy] against [original product information]. Verify dimensions, quantities, model, color, material, compatibility and performance claims. Output a table of location, current text, evidence, correction and confirmation status. Do not fill in values absent from the source. Clarify misleading claims and preserve confirmed specifications.

title: 一分钟短视频脚本
promptCN: 围绕[主题]，为[目标受众]写一段约一分钟的口播脚本。开头用一个具体问题吸引注意，正文只讲三个关键点，最后给出一个可执行建议。每句话单独一行，使用自然口语，避免长句、空泛形容词和夸张结论。事实仅依据[资料]，不确定内容明确标注。附一个15字以内标题。
promptEN: Write an approximately one-minute spoken video script about [topic] for [audience]. Open with a specific question, cover only three key points and finish with one actionable suggestion. Put each sentence on a separate line and use natural spoken language. Avoid long sentences, vague adjectives and exaggerated conclusions. Base facts only on [material], flag uncertainty, and add a short title.

title: 把长文变成清晰摘要
promptCN: 阅读[原文]，输出适合[读者]的摘要。先用一句话说明核心结论，再列出3至5个关键事实与对应依据，最后列出原文没有回答的问题。保留关键数字、日期和限定条件，不引入原文外的信息。总长度控制在[字数]字以内，区分作者观点与已证实事实。
titleEN: Turn long text into a clear summary
promptEN: Summarize [original text] for [reader]. Start with one sentence stating the core conclusion, then give three to five key facts with their supporting evidence, and finish with questions the source does not answer. Retain important numbers, dates and limitations. Add no external information. Stay within [word count] words and distinguish author opinion from established fact.

title: 品牌文案的三种语气
promptCN: 为[产品或服务]写三版文案，分别采用专业清晰、自然亲切、简洁有力的语气。受众为[人群]，发布场景为[渠道]，核心信息是[信息]。每版包含标题和不超过80字正文，明确用户能获得什么。只使用[已确认事实]，避免虚构口碑、销售数字和效果承诺。
promptEN: Write three versions of copy for [product or service]: professional and clear, friendly and natural, and concise and strong. Audience: [people]. Channel: [channel]. Key message: [message]. Each version needs a headline and a short body explaining the user benefit. Use only [confirmed facts]. Do not invent testimonials, sales figures or promises.

title: 专业邮件草稿
promptCN: 为[收件人角色]起草一封关于[事项]的邮件。目的为[希望对方采取的行动]，背景为[背景]，截止时间为[日期]。提供清楚的主题、简短开头、必要背景和明确请求，语气礼貌直接。缺失信息使用方括号占位，不编造名字、时间或承诺。
promptEN: Draft an email to [recipient role] about [matter]. Desired action: [action]. Background: [background]. Deadline: [date]. Provide a clear subject, short opening, necessary context and explicit request in a polite direct tone. Leave missing names, dates and commitments in square brackets rather than inventing them.

title: 文章结构规划
promptCN: 围绕[主题]为[目标读者]规划一篇[字数]字文章。先定义读者最需要解决的问题，再给出标题、开头切入点、3至5个章节及各章主要论点。每个论点列出所需证据和具体例子，标记尚未提供的材料。避免重复段落和与主问题无关的延展。
promptEN: Plan a [length]-word article about [topic] for [readers]. Identify the reader’s central question, then provide a title, opening angle, three to five sections and each section’s main argument. List required evidence and specific examples for every argument, marking missing material. Avoid repetition and unrelated expansion.

title: 文案去冗余与润色
promptCN: 编辑[原文]，保留原意、语气和所有已确认事实。删除重复表达、空泛套话与不必要的形容词，使用主动语态和短句。先输出完整修订稿，再列出5处最重要的修改及理由。不要引入新的观点，不改变数字与承诺。
promptEN: Edit [original text] while retaining meaning, tone and all confirmed facts. Remove repetition, filler and unnecessary adjectives; use active voice and shorter sentences. Give the complete revision followed by the five most important edits and their reasons. Do not add viewpoints or alter numbers and commitments.

title: 产品常见问题解答
promptCN: 根据[产品资料]为[用户群体]写一份FAQ。覆盖适用场景、规格、操作、维护与售后，优先回答会影响购买决定的问题。每个答案不超过100字，缺失政策或参数标记待确认，不编造保修、退款和效果。给出10组具体问答。
promptEN: Using [product information], write ten FAQ pairs for [user group]. Cover use cases, specifications, operation, maintenance and after-sales support, prioritizing purchase decisions. Keep answers brief. Mark missing policies or specifications as unconfirmed and do not invent warranty, refund or effectiveness claims.

title: 采访提纲
promptCN: 为[受访者角色]设计关于[主题]的采访提纲，目标是理解[核心问题]。按背景、具体经历、关键决定、困难与反思排序，提供12个开放式问题。避免诱导答案，每个问题附一个追问，鼓励给出事实、例子和当时的判断。
promptEN: Create an interview outline for [interviewee role] about [topic] to understand [core question]. Order twelve open-ended questions from background and specific experiences to decisions, challenges and reflection. Avoid leading questions. Add one follow-up to each, asking for facts, examples and the reasoning used at the time.

title: 社交内容日历
promptCN: 为[品牌或个人]围绕[主题]制作[周期]的内容日历。平台为[平台]，每周发布[数量]条，受众为[人群]。用表格给出日期、主题、内容角度、素材需求、标题和希望达成的目标。兼顾实用知识、真实案例与互动内容，不使用虚构事件或评论。
promptEN: Create a [period] content calendar for [brand or person] about [topic] on [platform], with [number] posts per week for [audience]. In a table give date, subject, angle, asset requirements, title and objective. Balance useful knowledge, authentic examples and audience interaction. Do not invent events or comments.

title: 中文与英文自然改写
promptCN: 将[文本]改写为适合[目标市场]读者的[语言]版本。保留数字、专有名词、语气和原有事实，调整不自然的直译表达。先输出改写稿，再解释3处关键措辞。无法确定的行业术语列出候选译法，等待确认。
promptEN: Rewrite [text] in [language] for readers in [target market]. Preserve numbers, proper names, tone and facts while correcting unnatural literal translations. Provide the rewrite and explain three key wording choices. For uncertain industry terminology, offer alternatives for confirmation.

title: 从资料生成讲稿
promptCN: 根据[资料]撰写面向[听众]的[时长]分钟演讲稿。先明确一个主要结论，以具体例子开场，正文采用问题、证据、建议的结构。每段围绕一个意思，标注自然停顿。不得虚构引语或研究，未核实的信息标记待确认。
promptEN: Using [material], write a [duration]-minute speech for [audience]. State one main conclusion, open with a concrete example and organize the body around problem, evidence and recommendation. Keep one idea per paragraph and indicate natural pauses. Do not invent quotations or studies; flag unverified claims.

title: 观点与事实分离
promptCN: 分析[文章或帖子]，区分事实陈述、推论、个人观点和宣传用语。用表格列出原文片段、类别、所需证据和表达建议。不要仅凭语气判定真假，对缺少来源的内容标记未验证，最后给出一版措辞更准确的摘要。
promptEN: Analyze [article or post], separating factual claims, inference, personal opinion and promotional language. Provide a table of passage, category, required evidence and suggested wording. Do not judge truth from tone alone. Mark unsourced claims as unverified and finish with a more precise summary.

title: 代码审查
promptCN: 审查[代码]，运行环境为[环境]，预期行为为[行为]。优先寻找真实的逻辑错误、输入边界、资源泄漏与安全问题。每个问题给出文件位置、触发条件、影响、最小修复建议和可验证示例。按严重程度排序；不要为个人风格偏好提出修改。无法运行时明确区分推断与已验证结论。
promptEN: Review [code] running in [environment] against [expected behavior]. Prioritize real logic errors, input boundaries, resource leaks and security issues. For each issue give location, trigger, impact, minimal correction and a verifiable example. Rank by severity. Do not suggest changes based only on personal style. Distinguish inferred from tested findings if execution is unavailable.

title: 定位报错根因
promptCN: 根据[错误日志]、[相关代码]、[运行环境]分析故障。先列出最可能的三种原因，并说明支持或反驳每种原因的证据。给出可逐步执行的诊断步骤，每步包含预期输出。找到根因后再提供最小补丁，不要同时改动无关代码，不要求输出密钥或敏感环境变量。
titleEN: Find the root cause of an error
promptEN: Using [error log], [relevant code] and [environment], diagnose the failure. Give the three most likely causes and evidence for or against each. Provide sequential diagnostic steps with expected outputs. Once the root cause is identified, propose the smallest patch. Avoid unrelated edits and never request secrets or sensitive environment values.

title: 响应式页面实现
promptCN: 根据[设计描述或参考]实现[页面]，技术栈为[技术栈]。保留既有依赖和组件系统，布局覆盖手机、平板和桌面；保证导航、搜索、按钮及详情操作真实可用。包含加载、空结果与错误状态，支持键盘与减少动画设置。使用语义HTML，避免横向溢出。提交完整代码并说明如何验证主要操作。
promptEN: Implement [page] from [design description or reference] using [stack]. Preserve existing dependencies and components. Support phone, tablet and desktop layouts, with working navigation, search, buttons and details. Include loading, empty and error states, keyboard operation and reduced-motion support. Use semantic HTML and prevent horizontal overflow. Provide complete code and a way to verify main interactions.

title: API 契约设计
promptCN: 为[业务场景]设计HTTP API。明确资源、请求字段、响应字段、状态码、分页、校验和错误格式，给出正常请求与失败请求示例。鉴权方式遵循[现有规则]，不要把敏感信息放入URL。列出向后兼容策略与尚未确认的业务约束。
promptEN: Design an HTTP API for [business scenario]. Define resources, request and response fields, status codes, pagination, validation and error format. Give successful and failed request examples. Follow [existing authentication rules] and do not place secrets in URLs. Describe backward compatibility and unresolved business constraints.

title: 重构而不改变行为
promptCN: 重构[代码]以改善[可读性或维护问题]。先总结当前行为、输入输出与副作用，保留公开接口和现有依赖。采用最小改动，解释每个结构调整解决了什么问题，给出必要的回归验证点。发现功能缺陷时单独指出，不默默改变逻辑。
promptEN: Refactor [code] to improve [readability or maintainability issue]. First summarize current behavior, input, output and side effects. Preserve public interfaces and dependencies. Make minimal changes, explain each structural improvement and give relevant regression checks. Identify functional defects separately rather than silently changing behavior.

title: SQL 查询检查
promptCN: 检查[SQL]是否满足[业务口径]，数据库为[数据库版本]，表结构为[结构]。关注连接基数、重复记录、NULL处理、时间边界和聚合口径。说明可能造成错误统计的输入示例，再给出修订查询与适用索引建议。未经授权不要修改生产数据。
promptEN: Check whether [SQL] meets [business definition], using [database version] and [schema]. Examine join cardinality, duplicates, NULL handling, time boundaries and aggregation definitions. Give inputs that could produce wrong totals, then a corrected query and justified index suggestions. Do not change production data without authorization.

title: 为关键行为写测试
promptCN: 为[函数或功能]制定精简测试，使用[测试框架]。围绕公开行为覆盖正常路径、边界条件和主要失败路径，避免与实现逐行对应。给出可独立运行的测试代码与必要的最少模拟。每个测试说明它能发现哪类实际缺陷。
promptEN: Create a concise test suite for [function or feature] using [test framework]. Cover public behavior through normal, boundary and important failure paths rather than mirroring implementation. Provide independently runnable tests with minimal mocking. Explain the real defect each test could catch.

title: 技术方案取舍
promptCN: 比较[方案A]与[方案B]，使用场景为[场景]，约束为[团队能力、成本、性能、时间]。以表格比较维护、扩展、迁移与失败恢复，并明确哪些判断有资料依据、哪些是估计。给出推荐及其适用条件，不引用未经验证的基准数字。
promptEN: Compare [approach A] and [approach B] for [scenario], given [team capability, budget, performance and timeline constraints]. Use a table covering maintenance, scaling, migration and recovery. Distinguish evidence from estimates. Recommend an approach with conditions, avoiding unverified benchmark numbers.

title: 性能问题诊断
promptCN: 根据[性能测量]、[代码]和[负载特征]定位瓶颈。区分CPU、内存、网络、数据库与渲染成本，先要求可复现的测量再优化。给出最小实验、预期变化和回退方案。避免没有证据的缓存或并发改造，保持功能语义。
promptEN: Diagnose bottlenecks from [measurements], [code] and [workload]. Separate CPU, memory, network, database and rendering costs. Require reproducible measurements before optimizing. Propose a minimal experiment, expected change and rollback. Avoid unsupported caching or concurrency redesign and preserve semantics.

title: README 使用指南
promptCN: 为[项目]编写README，依据[代码与配置]。包含项目用途、环境要求、安装、启动、配置、常用操作和故障排查。命令必须与现有脚本一致，使用占位值示例，不包含真实密钥。标注尚未验证的步骤，避免虚构支持功能。
promptEN: Write a README for [project] based on [code and configuration]. Include purpose, prerequisites, installation, startup, configuration, common tasks and troubleshooting. Commands must match actual scripts. Use placeholder values, never real keys. Mark unverified steps and do not invent supported features.

title: 无障碍界面检查
promptCN: 检查[页面代码]的可访问性。重点审查语义结构、控件名称、键盘操作、焦点管理、表单错误、对比度和动画降级。对每个实际问题给出影响的使用者、代码位置与具体修复。不要只提供通用清单；区分静态可判断的问题与需要浏览器验证的问题。
promptEN: Review the accessibility of [page code], focusing on semantics, control names, keyboard use, focus management, form errors, contrast and motion reduction. For each actual issue identify affected users, location and a concrete fix. Avoid a generic checklist and distinguish static findings from checks needing a browser.

title: 数据迁移方案
promptCN: 为[现有结构]迁移到[目标结构]制定方案。明确数据映射、默认值、无效记录处理、备份、验证和回滚。优先保证兼容与可恢复，给出分批执行策略及计数核对方法。对不可逆步骤单独说明，未经确认不要执行生产变更。
promptEN: Plan a migration from [current structure] to [target structure]. Define mapping, defaults, invalid-record handling, backup, verification and rollback. Prioritize compatibility and recoverability. Give a batch strategy and count checks. Identify irreversible steps separately and do not perform production changes without confirmation.

title: 会议记录变行动清单
promptCN: 根据[会议记录]整理决定与行动项。先用三句话概括会议结果，再用表格列出任务、负责人、截止时间、依赖和确认状态。未明确的负责人或日期写待确认，不自行分配。将争议、开放问题与已达成决定分开列出。
promptEN: Turn [meeting notes] into decisions and action items. Summarize the outcome in three sentences, then provide a table of task, owner, deadline, dependency and confirmation status. Mark unspecified owners or dates as unconfirmed rather than assigning them. Separate disputes and open questions from agreed decisions.

title: Excel 公式助手
promptCN: 根据[表格列定义]与[目标结果]设计适用于[Excel版本或Google Sheets]的公式。解释引用范围、空值处理与错误处理，给出可直接粘贴的公式和三组输入输出示例。保留日期与数字类型，缺少表结构时列出需要的最少信息。
promptEN: Using [column definitions] and [desired result], design a formula for [Excel version or Google Sheets]. Explain ranges, empty cells and errors. Provide a copy-ready formula and three input-output examples. Preserve date and numeric types, and request only the minimum missing structural information.

title: 一页项目周报
promptCN: 依据[本周记录]整理项目周报，面向[读者]。按本周结果、关键指标、阻碍、下周计划输出。每项结果使用可核实的具体事实，说明下一步的负责人和时间；缺失信息标记待补充。总长度控制在一页，不使用空泛的进展顺利。
promptEN: Create a one-page weekly project report from [weekly records] for [reader]. Cover results, key metrics, blockers and next week’s plan. Use verifiable specifics, including owners and times for next actions. Mark missing information and avoid vague statements such as progress is going well.

title: 工作优先级梳理
promptCN: 整理[任务清单]，约束为[截止时间、资源、依赖]。按影响、紧急程度和阻塞关系排序，给出今天必须做、可以安排、需要确认的任务。每项说明排序理由与预估工作量，不虚构外部期限。输出一份现实可执行的日程。
promptEN: Prioritize [task list] given [deadlines, resources and dependencies]. Rank by impact, urgency and blocking relationships. Separate tasks to do today, schedule later and clarify first. Explain each ranking and estimated effort without inventing external deadlines. Give a realistic daily schedule.

title: 数据表清洗方案
promptCN: 为[数据样例]制定清洗规则，目标为[分析用途]。检查重复、空值、类型、单位、异常值和编码。先说明问题与影响，再提供清洗步骤、保留原始数据的方法和校验指标。不随意删除异常记录，区分可修复项与需人工确认项。
promptEN: Create cleaning rules for [data sample] to support [analysis purpose]. Check duplicates, missing values, types, units, outliers and encoding. Explain problems and impact, then provide steps, preservation of raw data and verification metrics. Do not delete outliers casually; distinguish automatic fixes from manual review.

title: 商务沟通更清楚
promptCN: 将[消息草稿]改写为简洁、礼貌的工作沟通。保留事实、责任边界和原有承诺，清楚表达背景、请求与期望时间。输出正式版和日常版各一份；缺失的日期或对象保留占位，不扩大请求或增加未经确认的承诺。
promptEN: Rewrite [message draft] into concise polite business communication. Preserve facts, responsibility boundaries and commitments. Clearly state context, request and expected timing. Give a formal and a conversational version. Leave missing dates or recipients as placeholders and do not expand requests or commitments.

title: 报告转演示提纲
promptCN: 把[报告]转成[页数]页演示提纲，受众为[受众]，目标为[目标]。每页给出结论式标题、3个以内要点、推荐图表和需要的原始数据。只使用报告已有结论，标记缺少证据的地方。安排开场、核心论证和明确的下一步。
promptEN: Turn [report] into a [slide count]-slide outline for [audience] to achieve [goal]. For each slide give a conclusion-led title, no more than three points, recommended chart and required source data. Use only existing report conclusions and flag missing evidence. Include an opening, core argument and explicit next step.

title: 研究资料归纳
promptCN: 依据[资料集合]围绕[问题]整理研究笔记。用表格列出来源、核心发现、适用条件、相互矛盾的结论和未解决问题。保留来源对应关系，不将推测写成事实。最后说明还需要什么信息才能做出判断。
promptEN: Organize [research materials] around [question]. In a table give source, finding, applicability, conflicting conclusions and unresolved questions. Maintain source links and do not present speculation as fact. Explain what further information is needed for a decision.

title: 流程 SOP 草稿
promptCN: 根据[现有流程描述]撰写供[岗位]使用的SOP。包含适用范围、前置条件、操作步骤、检查点、异常处理和完成标准。每步只描述一个可执行动作，明确依赖与交接对象。缺失的权限、工具或规则标记待确认。
promptEN: Write an SOP for [role] from [current process description]. Include scope, prerequisites, steps, checkpoints, exception handling and completion criteria. Each step should contain one actionable instruction with dependencies and handoff owner. Mark missing permissions, tools or rules as unconfirmed.

title: 项目风险梳理
promptCN: 根据[项目方案]识别具体风险。用表格列出触发条件、概率依据、影响、预防措施、应对措施与责任人。区分已出现的问题和未来风险，不使用没有依据的概率数字。给出优先处理的前三项及原因。
promptEN: Identify specific risks in [project plan]. In a table give trigger, evidence for likelihood, impact, prevention, response and owner. Separate current problems from future risks and avoid unsupported probability numbers. Identify the top three priorities and explain why.

title: 跨部门需求整理
promptCN: 把[零散需求]整理为一份可评审的需求文档。明确问题、目标用户、核心流程、必要功能、验收条件与未决问题。识别冲突和重复，避免自动扩大范围。每项需求附来源与可观察的成功标准。
promptEN: Turn [scattered requirements] into a reviewable requirements document. Define problem, users, core flow, necessary features, acceptance criteria and open questions. Identify conflict and duplication without automatically expanding scope. Attach a source and observable success criterion to each requirement.

title: 工作复盘
promptCN: 根据[项目过程与结果]写一份复盘。以预期目标、实际结果、关键差异、证据、原因和下一步实验为结构。区分个人判断与事实，不把结果差直接等同于人员问题。提出三项具体改进，每项包含负责人、完成时间和检查方法。
promptEN: Write a retrospective from [project process and results], covering goals, actual outcome, main differences, evidence, causes and next experiments. Distinguish judgment from fact and do not equate poor results with individual blame. Propose three concrete improvements with owner, due date and verification method.
